source_window.resource_title: Official National Polygon Service dataset page
source_window.data_date: current official product page accessed 2026-10-03; service updated monthly

field_evidence.dataset_scope: The National Polygon Service contains the National Polygon dataset, Title Descriptor dataset, and Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset.
field_evidence.polygon_fields: The National Polygon dataset includes shape, polygon identification, title number, polygon creation date, update date, polygon-version information and record status.
field_evidence.uprn_linkage: The Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset links HM Land Registry title numbers to Unique Property Reference Numbers for registered land/property.
field_evidence.access_restriction: The full National Polygon Service is chargeable/restricted; the official page states a price of £20,000 plus VAT per year and requires agreeing the licence and paying before data/API access.
field_evidence.public_page_limitation: The public/no-login product page exposes dataset semantics and access terms, not the target-specific Forge Cottage title polygon, title number or UPRN record.
field_evidence.extent_semantics: HM Land Registry describes National Polygon boundaries as indicative shape and position; title plan/register remain the authoritative legal context.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry's official National Polygon Service explicitly contains the title-polygon geometry, title number and Title Number/UPRN relationship needed to bind registered land/property, but the full service is chargeable and restricted: access requires the National Polygon Service licence, payment and account sign-in/API authorisation. Under this producer's official public no-login constraint, no target-specific Forge Cottage polygon/title/UPRN record can be retrieved from this window. Local OpenCode or an authorised user-side HMLR workflow must obtain and spatially bind the target-specific registered-title polygon; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The official HM Land Registry National Polygon Service page is public/no-login to read and materially changes the method from council planning-register retrieval to the authoritative registered-title polygon data layer. The page states that the National Polygon dataset includes shape, polygon identification and title number, and that the Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset links title numbers to UPRNs. It also states that the service costs £20,000 plus VAT per year and requires the licence, payment and signed-in/API access. Therefore the target-specific polygon/title/UPRN record is not available inside this producer's public no-login window. No canonical parcel geometry is asserted and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
